title: Palindrome Range Queries
statement:
Compute odd and even Manacher radii, then answer whether each queried substring is a palindrome in O(1).

Input
One lowercase English string, then q and q inclusive 1-based ranges L R.

Output
Print YES or NO for each query.

Constraints
1 ≤ string length,q ≤ 200000. 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ length.
